```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
print(arrow::open_dataset("data/history.parquet", format = "parquet")$schema)

markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
history <- read_parquet("data/history.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(outcome_numeric = case_when(
    outcome == "YES" ~ 1,
    outcome == "NO" ~ 0,
    .default = NA_real_
  )) |>
  mutate(absolute_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric))

nrow(joined)
joined |>
  summarise(
    mean_absolute_error = mean(absolute_error),
    median_absolute_error = median(absolute_error)
  )

groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

glimpse(groups)
head(groups, 5)
nrow(groups)

glimpse(market_groups)
head(market_groups, 5)
nrow(market_groups)
```

`market_groups` links markets to topic slugs: a market can have multiple rows. `groups` is a lookup table keyed by `group_slug`, adding each topic's name, broad category, and market count.
